title: Alibaba and Device42 providers removed
quote: Please note that this release removed two of the unsupported and unmaintained providers Alibaba and Device42.
remediation: Move every ExternalSecret off the stores named before upgrading; 2.0's CRDs no longer accept `provider.alibaba` / `provider.device42` and their secrets stop syncing.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("alibaba") or has("device42")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is a store on a removed provider
coversNotes: v2.0.0 (General): chore: remove unmaintained secret stores
SecretStore provider alibaba removed from the CRD schema
SecretStore provider device42 removed from the CRD schema

title: 2.0.1: sprig's `htpasswd` template function now takes a third argument
quote: Looks like it's just the `htpasswd` function that was renamed.
remediation: In the templates of the ExternalSecrets named, add the hash algorithm to every `htpasswd` call before moving to 2.0.1+: `htpasswd .user .pass` becomes `htpasswd .user .pass "bcrypt"` (or `"sha"`). The two-argument form fails to render. Upstream's note calls it a rename; the sprig change is a signature change.
verifyCommand: kubectl get externalsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | (.spec.target.template // .spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template // {}) | tostring | select(test("htpasswd")) | $o | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row's template calls htpasswd
